technical_quality: Adequate PA film: good inspiration (~9-10 posterior ribs), no significant rotation, penetration adequate (vertebral bodies seen through the heart). Bilateral breast shadows overlie the lower zones. Black vertical band at the image left edge is a collimation/digitisation artifact, not patient-related.

image upper right, over the patient's left acromioclavicular / shoulder region

abnormalities.finding: Bulky, rounded left hilum with ill-defined hazy perihilar opacity lateral to it (possible perihilar consolidation vs enlarged pulmonary artery / hilar adenopathy) - most likely correlate of the label
Patchy hazy density and crowded bronchovascular markings in the right perihilar / infrahilar region along the right heart border
Small dense nodule (~0.5 cm) just lateral to the left hilum - likely calcified granuloma or end-on vessel
Mildly increased bilateral basal bronchovascular / reticular markings; no lobar consolidation, effusion or pneumothorax; costophrenic angles sharp; heart size normal

description_zh: PA 胸部 X 光，吸氣量足夠、無明顯旋轉，兩側乳房陰影重疊於下肺野。左側肺門影增寬、輪廓圓鈍，其外側中肺野可見邊界不清的淡片狀增濃，主動脈弓突出；右側肺門周圍沿右心緣亦見支氣管血管紋理增粗與斑片狀淡影，但未見明確的大葉性實變。兩側肋膈角清晰，無肋膜積液或氣胸，心臟大小正常，縱膈居中。未見任何管路、導線、夾子或植入物，僅見左側「L」標記及圓形外部標記物。
